The embedded checker passed 3,873 exact-rational finite-prefix assertions; those alone are not infinite-support proofs.

originality.rationale: DeSalvo 2026 Section 6 Open Problem 2 explicitly asks for a signed second-order approximation for arithmetic-mean-matched independent geometric summands. This result gives a specified signed correction, an all-parameter quadratic envelope, a cubic-scale residual and a sharp finite-tail local coefficient. Full-text inspection of that source and the 2016 Kumar–Upadhye operator-perturbation article did not find the claim. Closest indexed published items concern modes of negative multinomial cells, dispersion of Bernoulli sums, and unrelated cumulant envelopes. Historical priority remains provisional because the full original 2002 general signed-expansion paper was inaccessible; a broader general theorem may imply parts of the result.

value.rationale: This resolves a specifically stated 2026 research gap about mean-matched heterogeneous geometric sums: the first-order variation cancels but published error bounds are linear. The closed signed target is a difference of genuine NB laws with an all-parameter quadratic bound and a cubic residual, plus a sharp local tail coefficient. The object and its approximation sensitivity are natural for negative-binomial inference and occupancy systems; the improvement is not an arbitrary numerical cutoff.
